description: In this challenge, you and two other chosen companion will be bound together, navigating the vast realms of Azeroth as an inseparable Trio. From the moment you join forces, you'll be bonded by death, meaning if one of you dies, you all shall perish. Furthermore, you cannot leave the group, or you'll also instantly fail this challenge.
name: Trio

requirements.description: You must be in a party of |cffffffff3|r to attempt this challenge. If any party members fail their Trial, you will too.
requirements.name: Be in a party of 3
